english_taught_degrees.detail: English Track majors marked ★ (e.g. Global Business Administration (English) in the Division of International Studies)
english_taught_degrees.evidence: Departments or majors marked with “★” are part of the English Track, in which courses are offered in English.

language_rules.note: BUFS Korean Language Proficiency Test (Korean Language and Culture Education Center) Level 3+
language_rules.evidence: - Applicants who have obtained Level 3 or higher on the BUFS Korean Language Proficiency Test administered by the Korean Language and Culture Education Center - Applicants without a TOPIK score who are recognized as having Korean proficiency through the interview speaking assessment.
